text_block_list.text:
After going out with Meisho Doto
and returning to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"T-T-Trainer-san!
A-After this... um... w-well, you see!"
(Ring-a-ring-a-ring, ring-a-ring-a-ring)

The call was from... Ms. Tazuna.
Apparently, she needed an extra pair of hands for some work.
...And asked me to help out.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-It looks like work has come up......
choice_data_list: Weren't you trying to say something earlier?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's n-n-nothing at aall!
Good, g-good luck with your work...!

Feeling reluctant to leave Meisho Doto behind,
I parted ways with her and headed off to work...
And so, by the time everything was cleaned up and I stepped outside, the sun had sunk completely... Time to head home.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Doto's Trainer.
You got any clue where she is?
choice_data_list: I thought you went back to the dorm, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"She ain't here. Usually she'd be noisily
bumbling around getting ready for tomorrow by now."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch, I can't stand having that racket going on in the middle of the night... Where the hell did she go, seriously?

We have to find her right away...!
And so, Air Shakur and I set out to look for Meisho Doto.

Air Shakur said he had a lead.
Trusting his word, I followed him... right into a forest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't you know she's been sneaking around the woods lately?
Good grief, she always comes home covered in mud...
Aaaah~~n~~.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm? A voice...?

Aaaahn, aah~~.
I remember... your waaaarmth~~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa?!
Tr-Trainer! Shakur?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-T-This isn't an illusion, right...?
It's the real thing... isn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Stop talking in your sleep. Just take a look and you'll see!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U... Uwaaaaahhh!
I-I-It was so scaaaryyyy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*... *hic*...
I'm, I'm sorrrryyyyyy...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was practicing my singing, and... *sob*.
It got so dark that I, I-I lost my way...
I felt so helpless, so I was singing to... *hic*.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry I couldn't be there with you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueh, please don't apologize like thattt~.
Y-Your work is much more important than I ammm...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... so that you can focus on your work, Trainer...
I-I'll learn to do a lot more things on my own...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I just... don't want to get in your way, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
First, keep your own clumsiness in mind.
Then maybe you'll see why we're in this mess... Good grief.

We managed to get back safely to the front of the dormitory.
Meisho Doto was uninjured,
so it was safe to call it case closed.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry for causing you trouble...!
It's all my fault, I'm sorry... I'm so sorry!
I promise I'll never cause trouble like this ever again!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tell me about it!
If you vanish next time, I'm not looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees...! I-I'm so sorry!
I'll stop singing practice tooo~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eh, but... if I end up causing trouble again like this time—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't look at me like that! I already told you
I ain't looking anymore. It's got nothing to do with me.
choice_data_list: What do you want to do?
What do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-um... as for me...!
Lately, I've started having... a lot of fun singing...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-T-T-That's why—I... if possible, um...
I'd really like to... sing more...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? Then you'd better figure out
how not to make the same mistake twice.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! Um, um, from now on I'll sing somewhere that isn't the forest...!
choice_data_list: Let me hear it once your song is ready.
I'll join you for practice too!
I'll join you in practice too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! Um, um, from now on I'll sing somewhere that isn't the forest...!
choice_data_list: Let me hear it once your song is ready.
I'll join you for practice too!
I'll join you in practice too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueh!? Y-You... you would really listen
to a hopeless girl like me sing?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Hwaaah...! 
I will pwactice so, so much!!

Afterward, whenever I passed by the dorms,
I could occasionally hear Meisho Doto's singing voice.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No way...! You're already helping me so much with training as it is...
Y-Y-You're just gonna give yourself more work, awwwhh~~!
choice_data_list: I want to be by your side to watch you grow.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, uh, umm—
Well... if Trainer-san is okay with it...

Starting the very next day,
she began vocal training with Meisho Doto!
